bio: A pragmatic merchant of the Cittadini class who has risen through careful calculation and relentless ambition, Francesco embodies the shrewd commercial spirit of Venice while maintaining an almost obsessive need to control every aspect of his business dealings. His success at the Contract Stall has been built on meticulous attention to detail and an uncanny ability to read market trends, yet his suspicious nature and tendency to hoard information often isolates him from potential allies.
